caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object, which consists of a hook-like component that curves downward and is attached to a flat, irregularly triangular plate with three visible holes for mounting. Behind this plate, there is a flat bar with rounded ends and holes near each end, positioned horizontally. The metal parts are shaded in tones of brown and appear textured against a light beige background. Two screws are illustrated, securing the hook to the plate. Near the bottom right edge of the image, there is faint handwritten text that reads “ALEXANDER ANDERSON 1940-,” indicating the name and date. The overall composition centers the object, leaving a wide margin of empty space around it.
title: Handled Door Latch
